task: prepare a connector for directory review

families.label: Add the required privacy policy disclosures to the connector's files

variants.label: README section plus privacy_policies array in manifest.json (local connectors)
steps: Add a "Privacy Policy" section to README.md
Add a privacy_policies array to manifest.json
Point the entries at HTTPS privacy policy URLs
Cover data collection, usage and storage, third-party sharing, retention, and contact information
variants.notes: Missing or incomplete privacy policies result in immediate rejection.

families.label: Produce directory assets to the published specifications

variants.label: Carousel screenshots and paired prompt text (MCP Apps)
steps: Capture three to five PNG screenshots at least 1000px wide
Crop each to the app response only, leaving out the prompt
Provide the prompt text separately for each screenshot
Optionally start from the Anthropic MCP Apps Figma community carousel template
variants.notes: Video and GIF are not accepted; no separate mobile assets are required. Mechanism is 'other' because the text never says where the screenshots are produced.

families.label: Run the pre-submission checklist and validate before filing

variants.label: Pre-submission checklist, plus claude plugin validate for plugins
steps: Run the pre-submission checklist from the review criteria page
For plugins, run claude plugin validate
variants.notes: The checklist itself lives on the review-criteria page, which no record in this task covers.

claude.note: All three preparation stages (privacy policy files, carousel assets, checklist plus validate) appear only on the undistinguished Claude submission page.
